issues.issue: Wrong choices were just one or two off the answer
issues.now: Wrong choices are now tagged mistakes (counted the rock, doubled, off by one and so on), each with its own 'why' line and picture.

issues.issue: Tapping every choice costs nothing; the stone is for finishing
issues.now: Only the first tap of a go is scored, and a second wrong tap now starts a look-together. But the stone is still given for finishing, with no accuracy needed.

issues.issue: Pebble and bond steps were done for the child
issues.now: Pebbles: the child now drags or taps pebbles and presses Check (fixed). The bond step still offers four near numbers and says only 'Try again' after a miss.

issues.issue: Level 1 is repetitive (8 facts for 10 goes)
issues.now: Level 1 still repeats facts to fill 10 goes, and repeats are not counted as separate evidence.

issues.issue: Silver and gold days follow the calendar, not the child
issues.now: Day kind still comes from the day count, not from how the child is doing.

issues.issue: Hop-backs are only 2 goes, and only on gold days
issues.now: BACK_GOES is still 2 and only gold days have them.

issues.issue: Teacher had no Today alert or class grid for Weka
issues.now: Weka is in the teacher Foundational grid and has an alert feed.

issues.issue: No round summary of how the child did
issues.now: The finish screen shows the stone and a what's-next card but no accuracy or facts summary.

issues.issue: Rounds are deleted after 30 days
issues.now: The database still removes rounds older than 30 days.

issues.issue: Level 1 'hops to ten' step is always 1, so it can be guessed
issues.now: With a big number of 9 the first hop is always 1.

issues.issue: Pebble step stopped at ten (maths fidelity)
issues.now: The pebble step now builds the real number and checks it.

issues.issue: Three or four screens for every go
issues.now: A full-help go still has four phases (hop to ten, answer, pebbles, bond), and Check adds a tap.

issues.issue: Help fades slowly (about 12 days)
issues.now: Help ladder still needs 2 quick days and box 2 for split, then 8 and 12 right answers per fact.

issues.issue: 5 second quick rule penalised voice-led juniors
issues.now: Quick time is 10 s for juniors and the clock starts after the voice finishes.

issues.issue: Answer clock starts only after the hop-to-ten step
issues.now: The answer time still starts after the first step, so time on the first step is not measured.

issues.issue: Hints were the same whatever the child chose
issues.now: Hints now depend on which wrong choice was tapped.

issues.issue: Hints used are not saved
issues.now: The help level of the go is saved. Hints and look-togethers inside a go are not.

issues.issue: Reward is once a day and abstract
issues.now: One stone per finished day or challenge, with no link to what was learned.

issues.issue: Choice sets left out the nearest numbers
issues.now: Choices are now built from named mistakes, so the near numbers appear when they are real mistakes.

issues.issue: First go is fully told
issues.now: The first go is still a full walk-through. Kept by design.

issues.issue: Hop animations stall in a hidden browser
issues.now: Preview only. Could not be checked in code.

issues.issue: Answer stones may be cut off at 800x600
issues.now: Code only: no change made to the layout for small screens; best reading is unchanged.

issues.issue: Fading bug: step help and fade cancelled each other
issues.now: The cancel is fixed, but level 4 is kept as a floor on steps 2 to 4, so a perfect child keeps ten-frames for about 8 days.

issues.issue: Only 9 facts to practise
issues.now: Still numbers 1 to 9. Keys are now split into 18 (add and take away) but there are no new numbers.

issues.issue: 'Try again' only; the reversed number (41 for 14) was never named
issues.now: Wrong nests are tagged (reversal, tens-only and so on) with a why-line.

issues.issue: Fade after a third wrong tap
issues.now: Dropped. The thinning code is still there but nothing uses it.

issues.issue: Three nests could be guessed
issues.now: Four nests at every level.

issues.issue: Nothing on Today / no stuck signal for teachers
issues.now: Tūī is in the teacher grid and alerts.

issues.issue: 3.4 second pause after right answers
issues.now: RIGHT_MS is still 3400.

issues.issue: Progression: one range, no spiral, no link to Weka
issues.now: A what's-next card to Weka appears when the child is secure. Still one number range and no step 6 (ten more, ten less).

issues.issue: 'Hear it again' said a different line
issues.now: It now says the go's own line.

issues.issue: 'Take the ten away' picture showed all the berries
issues.now: The ten now flies away in the picture.

issues.issue: Right answer after a wrong first tap gets full praise
issues.now: After a look-together and redo, the child still gets the same praise as a first-try right.

issues.issue: Weakest fact appears twice in a round
issues.now: The weakest fact is still added at the end of the list.

issues.issue: Fact keys were not the way (add and take away shared a key)
issues.now: Separate keys for ten-and and ten-less.

issues.issue: 5 second quick rule
issues.now: 10 s for juniors and the clock starts after the voice.

issues.issue: Only teen-looking nest was the answer (fidelity)
issues.now: Wrong nests now also look like teens (reversal and so on).

issues.issue: Preview tools panel shown
issues.now: Preview only. Could not be checked.

issues.issue: No teacher view
issues.now: A Quick looks panel on the student page and a class function.

issues.issue: Keep-the-picture answers counted as progress
issues.now: Guided answers are saved as helped (practice only).

issues.issue: Reaction time not saved
issues.now: Thinking time is saved as ms.

issues.issue: Starting check short and starts at stage 4
issues.now: Dropped on purpose by R3 (left for James). Still 6 pictures, 2 per test, first test at stage 4.

issues.issue: Lucky guesses in the check pass a stage
issues.now: A stage is passed with 2 right out of 2.

issues.issue: Single-group feedback taught nothing
issues.now: Feedback now says the number and the groups, with the parts left out for one group.

issues.issue: Nothing after stage 7
issues.now: All stages become 'in flower' and the child is told more pictures are coming.

issues.issue: Maths holes in stages 1, 3 and 6
issues.now: Stage content in config is unchanged.

issues.issue: No demo before the first picture
issues.now: New children see a demo picture that stays on screen.

issues.issue: Buttons greyed out during 'Get ready'
issues.now: Buttons are disabled until the answer phase, plus a 1 s lock.

issues.issue: Single-dot and gap help wording
issues.now: Three help lines: look for groups, look carefully, how many empty squares.

issues.issue: Right and wrong gap answers got the same sentence
issues.now: Gap feedback begins 'Yes!' or 'Not quite.'

issues.issue: Review pictures in stage 6 used the wrong heading
issues.now: The heading comes from the picture's activity, same as before.

issues.issue: Guided mode only by a manual switch
issues.now: Still a checkbox on the home screen. Struggle gives help pictures but not guided mode.

issues.issue: Stage 3 to 4 is steep
issues.now: Stages unchanged.

issues.issue: Wrong answers teach nothing (sections 1 and 5)
issues.now: Quick looks was not in R5. A wrong answer shows the same picture with the number and groups, no named mistake.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: After the look-together shows the answer, all choices come back in the same order and the child taps the stone they just saw. It proves they watched, not that they know.

new.issue: Five-part go: pebbles now need a Check tap
new.detail: The drag-and-Check pebble step adds one more action to a go that already has four phases. Weaker juniors can run out of patience before the bond step.

new.issue: Split and bond steps still only say 'Try again'
new.detail: The new mistake why-lines were built for the answer step only. Misses in split and bond get no reason.

new.issue: A lucky fast guess counts as quick
new.detail: Quick days count speed for any right answer, so guessing can move help down the ladder.
'You are so good at this!' praises the child, not the effort or the strategy.

new.issue: Redo after look-together can be copied
new.detail: The look-together says and shows the answer, then the redo shows the same four nests reversed. The child can tap the one they were just told.

new.issue: Ten-frames stay on for about 8 days for a perfect child
new.detail: Floor of level 4 on steps 2 to 4 was kept on purpose. A child who is right every day still sees full pictures for over a week, which slows fading.

new.issue: Dead code: picture thinning after wrong taps
new.detail: pictureFor still works out thinner nests but nothing uses it. Misleading for the next person.

new.issue: Praise for a redo is the same as for first try
new.detail: After a look-together the redo earns 'Well done!' even though the answer was just shown.

new.issue: Start step and 'secure' only use the add facts
new.detail: The take-away facts have their own keys now but startFor uses only the add keys, so a child weak at taking away is not noticed.

new.issue: Reading aloud is off by default
new.detail: The saved setting is false until switched on, so pre-readers get no voice unless a grown-up turns it on, even though all the clips now exist.

new.issue: No second try at the same picture
new.detail: After a wrong answer the child is shown the answer and moves on. They never try the same picture again.

new.issue: Slow answer (over 4 seconds) counts as struggling
new.detail: A careful child who thinks for over 4 s gets help pictures and the helped answer does not count towards the stage.

new.issue: Guided mode never grows the garden
new.detail: Because answers with the picture kept on are practice only, a child on this setting can never finish a stage. The summary tells them, but the setting is for children who most need it.

new.issue: Stage placement uses only 2 pictures per test
new.detail: One slip or one lucky guess moves the start by several stages.
The spoken picture description gets the plural wrong for one counter, for screen readers.

moves.reason: Support code is unchanged. The second review said a 4 needs a demo for each new skill, and Weka only demos the first go (smaller-first and hop-back have none).
R5 made wrong choices into named mistakes with why-lines, pictures, a look-together and a redo.
Same as Weka: graded help is unchanged, but the second review wanted a demo for each new way of asking.
R1 fixed the bug where step help and fade cancelled. Only partly better, as level 4 is a floor on steps 2 to 4.
Step rule is unchanged, but R9 split the keys and R8 added a link on to Weka. A modest gain, partly a kinder reading.
R5 names the reversal and other mistakes, with a why-line, a look-together and a redo.
R3 saves the thinking time and marks guided answers as helped; R7 added the teacher panel and class function.
